message: outline suppressed in html[data-kokuen-version="5"] :where( input:not([type]), input:is([type="text"], [type="search"], [type="email"], [type=; prove one replacement geometry
reason: Text-like inputs, textareas and custom-select combobox and locale-choice dropdown triggers replace the generic rectangle by brightening their own border with the neutral field-focus token (decision 0045), so there is one edge, not a line drawn over it. Invalid fields retain a danger indicator. Forced colors restores a Highlight outline for independent fields; action, choice, slider and color-control rings remain. Inputs acting as buttons keep their full control outline. Underline fields such as date pickers recolor their bottom border in a separate rule.
